title: Survive a DDoS attack or major outage
summary: In the first minutes, pick one incident commander and one channel. Then work out what you are in: a volumetric L3/4 flood, an application-layer attack, or a self-inflicted outage that looks like one. Edge mitigation and WAF rules can be agent-driven on the judged edge platforms. What stays human: deciding what to block, talking to customers, the postmortem (its own process: 'Run an incident postmortem'). While an attack is live, a current status page beats silence.
